content.short: Binary Ninja eBPF is a Capstone-powered disassembler and lifter for Solana bytecode.
content.description: Binary Ninja eBPF is a Capstone-powered disassembler and lifter for Solana bytecode, delivered as a Binary Ninja plugin. It takes raw Solana bytecode and translates it into readable, Solidity-like code, enabling developers to inspect and analyze Solana programs more easily. As an open-source project, the plugin provides visibility into the low-level instruction stream and structure of Solana binaries. The GitHub page offers easy-to-follow instructions for implementing and using the plugin.

resources.title: Reverse Engineering a Closed-Source Program
resources.tldr: Solana compiles Rust to a modified eBPF. The write-up on building a disassembler and lifter for it, from the researchers who did.

resources.title: What the Plugin Adds
resources.tldr: Instruction lifting and Solana SDK structures on top of Binary Ninja, so bytecode reads as something close to source.
